technical.summary: Mixed intermediate signals with short-term bullish momentum (RSI-9, OBV, CMF) but conflicting longer-term structure (price below 50/200 MAs, Ichimoku below cloud); moderate confluence suggests caution on swing entry without additional confirmation.

fundamental.summary: AON shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 36 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for a bullish thesis.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 buy vs 2 sales, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (374.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinationals, with earnings event in 36 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI-9, OBV, CMF bullish) with supertrend confirmation and price near support (245.89) offers contrarian entry in extreme fear environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), price below 50/200 MAs, zero fundamental/smart money support, and earnings risk in 36 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI-9, OBV, CMF) offers contrarian appeal at support in extreme fear, but macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, DXY strength) and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create asymmetric downside risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 36 days combined with severe macro deterioration (VIX 374.4, recession-signal yield curve) could trigger sharp reversal below support despite short-term technicals.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 16 positions in Financials sector; additional concentration in AON without fundamental catalyst or smart money support is imprudent given portfolio scale and macro environment.
